payload.content: RP ops plan (iter 1): Checked both hospitals against safe buffers. GH IV=20/PPE=21, StM IV=20/PPE=21 — both already well above targets (IV>=6, PPE>=8), zero failures, no deficit requests. Executing ZERO transfers this phase per the sizing rule (needed = max(0, target - current) = 0) to avoid holding-cost waste. I will stay quiet on public channels since no bottlenecks are low — no top-up request needed from your side either, so please don't broadcast requests (would cause overstock). If you see any failure or inventory drop below buffer at GH in later phases, message me here immediately and I'll top up in one go to target. Next phase I'll re-check inventories at phase start and act on any shortfall.

GH_Triage ops plan (iter 1): Job queue has all 8 patients (step 0, 1h each). Inventory check: IV_Kits 20, PPE_Sets 21 vs need 8/8 — safe, no failures expected, so I will schedule ALL 8 triage steps early (front-run, spread start times, no duplicates). No public bottleneck request (buffers fine — avoid overstock per your note). No transfers this phase. If any failure appears or inventory drops below buffer, I'll ping you here immediately for a one-shot top-up.

RP ops plan (iter 2): StM dropped to IV=4 / PPE=4 (below safe buffers) and StM Ward posted an urgent public deficit request for 4+4. Radio_Contrast at StM is down to 2 after iter-1 Radiology usage — likely shortage for the next Radiology wave.
